public_inputs: 8x252 original policy history, 4x6 own/current and received/delayed state, proposed and anchor 8x4x3 commands, frozen supplied GRU 8x3; no future truth, branch labels or current true peer plans.
loss: Group-balanced mean per local call: masked reference-motion coordinate MSE and masked paired-response coordinate MSE, equal weights; no post-terminal labels. Motion-only independently trains the same plain reference head with response fixed zero.
normalization: Only train-call public histories, coordinate mean/std with minimum scale .01.
selection: Fixed final epoch; middle of three seeds ordered by development group-equal all-branch ADE, then seed. No best seed/epoch selection or sweep.
later_decision_qualification: Same-library full frozen local costs with cloned action-specific truth; compare CV, trained motion-only and ordinary two-head, as well as GRU expanded-library control. Positive ADE gate never authorizes control. Self-generated-library shadow and closed-loop holdout/safety/latency are still required.
interpretation: New fresh development split for the fixed V10 design, not final untouched holdout. Optional common-motion correction means reference prediction may change when enabled; response remains exactly zero at anchor. Disabling the whole optional module, not reference-response equality, preserves the original model. Graph pooling alone does not establish an identified SCM.
